title: Смягчение высказываний (hedging): tend to, appear to, it seems, arguably

why: В английском (особенно в письме, отчётах и на переговорах) прямое утверждение часто звучит слишком резко или рискованно. Hedging — это способ сказать «похоже», «как правило», «пожалуй», не утверждая ничего на 100%. В русском это «кажется», «как правило», «по-видимому», «пожалуй».
formation: • subject + seem / appear + to + глагол: He seems to know the system.
• subject + seem / appear + to have + V3 (о прошлом): She seems to have forgotten.
• It seems / appears that + предложение: It seems that the server is down.
• subject + tend to + глагол: Developers tend to underestimate deadlines. Отрицание: tend not to / don't tend to.
• Наречия: arguably, apparently, presumably, probably, somewhat, relatively. Arguably ставим перед сказуемым или прилагательным: It is arguably the best option.
• Глаголы: suggest, indicate, imply: The data suggests that users prefer dark mode.
• Модальные и прочие: may, might, be likely to, in most cases, generally.
usage: 1. Предположение по внешним признакам: The client appears to be unhappy. (Клиент, похоже, недоволен.)
2. Общая тенденция, не закон: Prices tend to rise in summer. (Цены, как правило, растут летом.)
3. Спорное мнение: Arguably, Python is the easiest language to learn. (Пожалуй, Python — самый простой язык для изучения.)
4. Результаты исследований, выводы: The results suggest that the new design is better. (Результаты говорят о том, что новый дизайн лучше.)
5. Вежливое несогласие и критика: It seems to me that there may be a problem here. (Мне кажется, здесь может быть проблема.)
signalWords: seem, appear, tend, arguably, apparently, presumably, somewhat, to some extent, in most cases, generally, likely, suggest, indicate.
mistakes: ✗ He is seemed to be tired → ✓ He seems to be tired (seem не употребляется в пассиве).
✗ It seems that she to be late → ✓ It seems that she is late / She seems to be late (после that нужно целое предложение).
✗ She tends being late → ✓ She tends to be late (после tend — to + глагол).
✗ Obviously, he has resigned (это просто слух) → ✓ Apparently, he has resigned (apparently = «судя по всему», а не «очевидно»).
✗ Arguable, this is the best → ✓ Arguably, this is the best (нужно наречие).
remember: Seem / appear / tend + to, а для прошлого — to have + V3; arguably — наречие «пожалуй», apparently — «судя по всему», не «очевидно».

items.prompt: He ___ (seem) to know the system well.
items.answer: seems

items.prompt: Developers ___ (tend) to work late before a release.
items.answer: tend

items.prompt: It ___ that the server is down. (appear)
items.answer: appears

items.prompt: She appears ___ (be) tired today.
items.answer: to be

items.prompt: This is ___ the best framework for small projects. (adverb from: arguable)
items.answer: arguably

items.prompt: Teenagers ___ to spend a lot of time online. (tend)
items.answer: tend

items.prompt: They seem ___ (finish) the work already.
items.answer: to have finished

items.prompt: ___, the meeting has been moved. (adverb from: apparent)
items.answer: Apparently

items.prompt: She (a) seems being (b) seems to be angry.
items.answer: (b) seems to be

items.prompt: It appears (a) that (b) to the bug is in the API.
items.answer: (a) that

items.prompt: Managers tend (a) avoiding (b) to avoid risks.
items.answer: (b) to avoid

items.prompt: (a) Arguable (b) Arguably, Python is the easiest language to learn.
items.answer: (b) Arguably

items.prompt: There (a) seems (b) seem to be a problem with the login page.
items.answer: (a) seems

items.prompt: He (a) appears to have (b) appears having left already; his desk is empty.
items.answer: (a) appears to have

items.prompt: Prices tend (a) to rise (b) rising in December.
items.answer: (a) to rise

items.prompt: (a) Obviously (b) Apparently, he has resigned, but nobody has confirmed it.
items.answer: (b) Apparently

exercises.instruction: Смягчите утверждение, используя слово в скобках

items.prompt: He is unhappy with his job. (seem)
items.answer: He seems to be unhappy with his job. / It seems that he is unhappy with his job.

items.prompt: Cats sleep more than dogs. (tend)
items.answer: Cats tend to sleep more than dogs.

items.prompt: This is the best solution. (arguably)
items.answer: This is arguably the best solution.

items.prompt: The client didn't like the offer. (Begin with: It appears that)
items.answer: It appears that the client didn't like the offer.

items.prompt: Our users don't read the instructions. (tend)
items.answer: Our users tend not to read the instructions. / Our users don't tend to read the instructions.

items.prompt: The data proves that the app is slow. (suggest)
items.answer: The data suggests that the app is slow.

items.prompt: She forgot the meeting. (seem)
items.answer: She seems to have forgotten the meeting. / It seems that she forgot the meeting.

items.prompt: The update will fix the problem. (likely)
items.answer: The update is likely to fix the problem. / It is likely that the update will fix the problem.

items.prompt: He is seemed to be tired.
items.answer: He seems to be tired.

items.prompt: It seems that she to be late.
items.answer: It seems that she is late. / She seems to be late.

items.prompt: People tends to forget passwords.
items.answer: People tend to forget passwords.

items.prompt: She tends being late for meetings.
items.answer: She tends to be late for meetings.

items.prompt: Arguable, this is the best option.
items.answer: Arguably, this is the best option.

items.prompt: Obviously, the CEO is leaving, but I only heard it from a colleague. (это слух, не факт)
items.answer: Apparently, the CEO is leaving, but I only heard it from a colleague.

items.prompt: The results appear to being wrong.
items.answer: The results appear to be wrong.

items.prompt: The old version seems have worked better.
items.answer: The old version seems to have worked better.

items.prompt: Похоже, сервер не отвечает.
items.answer: It seems that the server isn't responding. / The server doesn't seem to be responding.

items.prompt: Разработчики, как правило, недооценивают сроки.
items.answer: Developers tend to underestimate deadlines.

items.prompt: Он, кажется, уже ушёл.
items.answer: He seems to have left already. / He seems to have already left.

items.prompt: Это, пожалуй, лучший ресторан в городе.
items.answer: This is arguably the best restaurant in the city.

items.prompt: По-видимому, клиент недоволен ценой.
items.answer: Apparently, the client is unhappy with the price. / The client appears to be unhappy with the price.

items.prompt: Данные показывают, что пользователи предпочитают тёмную тему.
items.answer: The data suggests that users prefer the dark theme.

items.prompt: Она, кажется, немного нервничает.
items.answer: She seems a bit nervous. / She seems to be a little nervous.

items.prompt: Цены, как правило, растут летом.
items.answer: Prices tend to rise in the summer. / Prices tend to go up in summer.
